meta.title: How a Session Gets Built
meta.subtitle: Worlds are created by a state graph, not by the bootstrap; scenes are routed by a bit mask; and a player is two entities, only one of which is disposable

views.label: Worlds are deferred
views.note: Startup creates one world. Everything else is created by a node in a graph, and destroyed when that state exits.

views.label: Which scene, which world
views.note: A set carries a world mask. The loader ands it against the flags of the world it is running in.

views.label: The gate that is off
views.note: Approval is off by default, and nothing else grants the identity the spawner requires.

views.label: Two entities per player
views.note: The controller is the account. The controlled entity is the body. Disconnecting disables, it does not destroy.
